name: polynomial chaos
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 用正交多项式表示随机输入与响应关系的方法框架。

complete_examples.text: The most outstanding feature of the PCE model is that the output random variable can be explicitly expressed in a suitable space spanned by the polynomial chaos (PC) basis.

Fortunately, the widespread application of meta models such as the polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) in the field of uncertainty provides new ideas for estimating the statistical moments of response functions.
